key_insight: onPanda speeds up alignment-data annotation by letting humans correct model outputs at the token level instead of rewriting whole responses. This makes it easier to create on-policy training data for LLMs and agents while preserving the model’s generation flow.
problem_solved: Annotating alignment data for LLMs and agent trajectories is slow and inefficient when annotators must edit full responses or trajectories. The paper addresses the need for a more precise, faster way to correct model outputs during generation.
method: Annotators read a generated response and identify the first inappropriate token.
They correct that token either by selecting from candidate tokens or by free-form text entry.
The system truncates text after the corrected position and resumes generation from the edited prefix, enabling iterative on-policy correction.
impact: This matters because it lowers the cost and time of producing high-quality alignment data for training and evaluating LLMs and agents. Practitioners can more efficiently build datasets that better reflect real model behavior during generation.
visual_elements: A before-and-after flow showing full-response editing vs. token-level correction
A step-by-step pipeline diagram of locate → correct → truncate → regenerate
An interactive UI mockup highlighting the first incorrect token in a generated response
An icon-based comparison of candidate-token selection versus free-form editing
paper_title: onPanda: Efficient Annotation of On-Policy Alignment Data for LLMs and Agents via Token-Level Correction
paper_authors: Lei Yang, Mengyin Liu, Jia Wang, Hangyu Guo, Liang Zhao
